title: My Free Time
text:
I like to play football on Saturdays. My friends and I meet in the park at ten o'clock. We play for one hour. Then we eat ice cream.

On Sundays I read books at home. My favourite book is about animals. My sister likes to draw pictures. She draws cats and dogs.

questions.text: What time do the writer and their friends meet in the park?
What is the writer's favourite book about?
How does the writer feel about playing football?

vocabulary.definition: a large public place with grass and trees where people walk or play
to make a picture with a pencil or pen
a cold sweet food made from milk or cream

paragraph_translations: Eu gosto de jogar futebol aos sábados. Meus amigos e eu nos encontramos no parque às dez horas. Jogamos durante uma hora. Depois comemos sorvete.
Aos domingos eu leio livros em casa. Meu livro favorito é sobre animais. Minha irmã gosta de desenhar figuras. Ela desenha gatos e cachorros.
